message:
The other day, as the weather reports hinted at something less than pleasant heading our way, our family group chat erupted into a flurry of messages. My daughter was sending out her usual ‘What should I do?’ queries, while my son was busy sharing links to the latest memes about ‘hurricane snacks.’ I chimed in with a reminder to check the flashlight batteries, and suddenly, we were all reminiscing about that time we made s’mores in the living room during a storm. 

Amidst the laughter and chaos, I realized that these chats not only keep us connected but also help us stay a bit more prepared, even if it’s just in spirit. Who knew a family group chat could be a storm survival tool? What’s your go-to tip for keeping everyone in the loop during a weather event? 🌧️
